title: 第2774章 五大族神王来袭第2773章 生死之间
content_zh:
生死城主破境的刹那。
人族至尊古路四大准神王同时失声惊呼。
封星神主眸光骤亮，难以置信道：“城主大人在生死两分的基础上，竟然更进一步，踏入了更高的生死之间层次。”
炎宵神主亦是神色震动，声音中翻涌着难以抑制的激动：“城主大人在三个半元会踏入神王大境，又是一个元会岁月中将生死大道修炼至‘生死两分’之境，已是惊世骇俗，没想到如今竟能在生死殿主的压迫之下，修成更高层次的生死之间。现在的城主大人，只怕是已经隐约间窥见到了神尊领域！”
其余两位古路护道者面面相觑，眼中翻涌着难以置信的震撼。
但更多的是一种惊喜。
一旦修成了生死之间，说明距离生死合一，已经不久矣。
修成生死合一，便是神尊。
生死神殿一方，三大底蕴级老古董同时瞪大了双眼，浑浊的老眼中翻涌着震惊与不可思议。
“少神子竟然真的突破了。”
“生死之间。那是比生死两分更高一层的境界。殿主当年穷尽三十万年才摸到生死之间的门槛，少神子却在这等绝境之中一举突破。”
“这才四个元会多点而已，如果再给少神子一点时间，未必不能在六个元会内修成神尊，可称之为生死神殿史上最强者……，不过可惜了……”
言语中满是惋惜。
但惋惜什么，唯有三人方才知道。
副殿主望着那道在生死神光中傲然独立的身影，神色复杂到了极致，最终化为一声悠长的叹息，低声自语：“少神子，你终究还是走到了这一步。如果当初……”
“唉……”
……
生死城主长啸一声，声波如雷震荡九霄。
身上的神威更胜往昔，不止一截而已。
从生死两分，突破至生死之间。

说明是修为境界的突破。
全方位地提升。
生死城主左手握住死亡神斧。
右手持掌一根碧绿如玉的生命神杖。
生死大道，彻底具象化体现，化作了生死二神兵。
身形一动，死亡神斧朝着生命殿主当头劈落，斧芒如同一道横贯天穹的灰色天堑，所过之处连大道规则都被斩断。
生命神杖则横扫而出，碧绿神光如同一片复苏万物的春雨，裹挟着磅礴的生命伟力，朝着死亡殿主席卷而去。
生命殿主分身，以及死亡殿主分身，齐齐变色，第一时间避退。
因为感应到如今‘生死之间’的生死城主有多可怕。
但来不及了。
轰！
轰！
两道攻击同时命中。
生命殿主被死亡神斧劈得倒飞出去，神圣的身躯上留下一道深可见骨的狰狞伤口，碧绿神血洒落长空。
死亡殿主则被生命神杖横扫正中胸膛，灰暗的身躯剧烈震颤，死亡道韵在生命之力的冲刷下寸寸崩裂，连退数十万里才勉强稳住身形。
content_en:
The moment the Lord of Life and Death broke through.
The four quasi-god kings of the human race's supreme ancient road simultaneously exclaimed in surprise.
Star Sealing God Lord's eyes suddenly brightened and he said in disbelief: "On the basis of the distinction between life and death, the Lord of the City has actually gone one step further and entered a higher level between life and death."
Divine Master Yanxiao also looked shocked, and his voice was filled with uncontrollable excitement: "My Lord, City Lord, stepped into the realm of God King in three and a half Yuanhui years, and in another Yuanhui years, he cultivated the path of life and death to the realm of 'life and death'. I didn't expect that under the pressure of the Lord of Life and Death, he could cultivate a higher level of life and death. Now, Lord City Lord, I'm afraid I have vaguely glimpsed the realm of God!"
The other two ancient road protectors looked at each other with unbelievable shock in their eyes.
But it was more of a surprise.
Once you have completed the practice of between life and death, it means that it has not been long since the time when life and death have become one.
To achieve the unity of life and death is to become a god.
On the side of the Temple of Life and Death, the three heritage-level antiques opened their eyes wide at the same time, with shock and disbelief filling their muddy old eyes.
"Young God Son actually made a breakthrough."
"Between life and death. That is a higher realm than the two divisions between life and death. It took the palace master 300,000 years to reach the threshold between life and death, but the young son of God broke through this desperate situation in one fell swoop."
"This is just a little more than four Yuanhui. If you give the Young God Son a little more time, he may not be able to cultivate into a god within six Yuanhui. He can be called the strongest in the history of the Temple of Life and Death... But it's a pity..."
The words were full of regret.
But what is the regret, only the three of them know.
The deputy palace master looked at the proudly independent figure in the divine light of life and death, his expression extremely complicated, and finally turned into a long sigh, and whispered to himself: "Young Godson, you have finally reached this step. If only..."
"Alas..."
…
The Lord of Life and Death City roared loudly, and the sound waves shook the sky like thunder.
The divine power on his body is greater than before, just by a small margin.
From the separation of life and death, to the breakthrough between life and death.
It shows that it is a breakthrough in the realm of cultivation.
Improve all aspects.
The Lord of Life and Death City holds the Death Ax in his left hand.
The right hand holds a jade-green staff of life.
The avenue of life and death was completely embodied and turned into the two divine weapons of life and death.
With a movement of his body, the God of Death's ax fell headlong towards the Lord of the Palace of Life. The light of the ax was like a gray chasm across the sky, and even the rules of the avenue were cut off wherever it passed.
The Divine Scepter of Life swept out, and the green divine light was like a spring rain that revived all things, carrying the majestic power of life and rolling towards the Chairman of the Death Hall.
The clones of the Lord of Life Palace and the clones of the Lord of Death Palace all changed their colors and immediately retreated.
Because he sensed how terrifying the city lord of life and death was now 'between life and death'.
But it was too late.
boom!
boom!
The two attacks hit simultaneously.
The Lord of the Life Palace was knocked backwards by the Death God's axe, leaving a hideous wound on his sacred body with bones visible, and green divine blood spilled into the sky.
The Lord of the Death Palace was swept across the chest by the Divine Scepter of Life, and his gray body trembled violently. The Death Dao Yun cracked inch by inch under the wash of the power of life, and he retreated hundreds of thousands of miles before barely regaining his balance.
